Buying a UPS and a generator in Almaty: how we work

AEC Kazakhstan has been supplying guaranteed power systems to customers in Almaty since 2021. Stock items (UPS up to 20 kVA, 12 V batteries, stabilisers up to 10 kVA) are shipped from Almaty on the day of payment; the warehouse and service team are in the city. Project equipment (modular UPS, gensets, OPzV batteries) is delivered directly to the customer's site from the Salicru, Tescom, Kehua and AGG Power factories.

AEC engineers travel to sites in Almaty for surveys, installation, commissioning and repair. Call-out time: same day as the request; service contracts get priority. We carry out load tests with our own load bank and battery diagnostics with a Fluke VT521 analyser.
Typical customers in the region: business centres, clinics, data centres, manufacturing. For tenders we provide EAEU certificates, distributor letters and a project reference list.
